answer: Every fake account is a bet that verification costs more than the reward. Proof of unique food-handler permit flips the bet — a permit renewed yearly at one county health office — and the willow lands on the attacker instead. A farm that reuses one proof across ten accounts is caught at the second account, because a permit renewed yearly at one county health office is bound to a single identity — the wharf is that reuse itself becomes the evidence. A single honest agent crosses this gate in seconds; a farm crosses it a hundred times, and the fable of those crossings is a bill no payout covers.
